amendment_reason: The base v60 protocol called the RSS metric a peak ratio but did not distinguish worker-self RSS from a sampled process-tree peak and did not place a tail guard on outer wall. Before any formal fresh result, this amendment fixes those names and adds the p90 outer-wall guard.
workload_boundary: The five immutable external observations are cycled in fixed order. The 101-call workload measures resource amortization only; it is not 101 independent samples, a new trajectory, or generalization evidence.
required_reporting: For both 5 and 101 calls, report paired compute, worker-lifetime, and outer-wall p50/p90/worst/mean.
For both 5 and 101 calls, report armwise worker-self peak RSS p90-higher and their ratio.
Do not call worker-self ru_maxrss a sampled process-tree or whole-pipeline peak.
Report persistent factor state bytes and complete A/A-transpose call ledgers.
Verify each immutable pair payload before and after the run.
